event.text: Send this to a Counsel clinician in this thread today for assessment and possible antibiotic treatment; your burning and frequent urination fit a likely simple bladder infection. Meanwhile, drink fluids. If you develop fever, chills, back or side pain, vomiting, blood in urine, or symptoms worsen quickly, seek same-day in-person care regardless of whether a message reply has arrived.
